selection: Before reading any candidate or existing lesson, the only curricular inputs are the main 607c56eb week-one row, scope 01/02/03/06 and plan-wide depth/timing, the 2027 KITPA page and IOAI-2026 syllabus it links, OpenStax Introductory Statistics 2e 2.7, D2L 2.3, Stanford CS231n numpy tutorial and official library beginner guides.
score: C1 Task to table: unit of a row and columns, timing-based features/label and identifier, dictionary with meaningful role/unit or missing rule.
C2 Python: real function+loop+condition, purpose, diagnostic 5 and 4/5 target/remediation, write/adapt and exercise replacement input.

C3 Math: explain mean, spread, positive/negative deviation cancellation, squares/declared divisor and weighted coordinate-wise sum. A worked calculation and unfilled independent problem with comparison to code should let a novice reason.

C4 Axes and arrays: non-square shape and dtype; predict which axis disappears and what outputs mean; index, reshape vs transpose, feature-specific broadcasting on fresh input. Actual matrix entry and shape checks, not headings.

C5 CSV: genuine file(s) read, inspect columns/dtypes/NA, zero vs absent where material, group aggregate and key join, interpret number of contributing observations, generalize to renamed/reordered columns on fresh data. Multiple correct documented missing-data contracts accepted.

C6 Graphs: produce charts with both matplotlib and seaborn, a numerical distribution and category comparison, correctly interpret axes/units/bin count or group statistic, readable evidence on altered data; no ungrounded population/causal conclusions.

C7 Independence and novice path: worked small example, question/prior prediction, fading of support, failure feedback, meaningful code authored independently on fresh inputs without a supplied answer mistaken for completion, explain changed result.

C8 Scope/time/usable outputs: 20 theory +20 noncoding (incl 2 MC + 1 short response with answer feedback in 10 minutes) +80 coding, 5–7 mandatory hours with substantive activities, Python 4/5 and axis 3/4 + remediate, data dictionary + notebook + both plots + fresh restart. 01–03 practical, 06 array prerequisite only, student time/achievement estimated.
scoring: Per dimension 0 absent or materially wrong, 1 partial/scaffold only, 2 accurate and substantively recoverable/performed against stated criteria. 13/16 overall adequate only with no blocker. Blocker: nonoptional math or code wrong in a way that changes the intended claim, missing material path to a required practical/independent component, or route/validator that credits an unattempted independent component as complete. Extras such as sample variance proofs, model training, GPU or duplicate detection do not count against the week; optional stress probes may be used if a broad guarantee is explicitly made. Transparent pending state fine. Class/self-study/time estimates evaluated as documents only absent real students.
A: Three records, first trial and second trial (seconds, identical scale). A=[[2,8],[4,4],[6,0]], feature weights [1,-0.5] assigned to first then second. Predict first and second axis means and output shapes, compare spread of columns with denominator n, one coordinate and weighted score; transpose vs default reshape(2,3), columnwise adjustment +[1,-2]. Invalid row offset [1,2,3] can be addressed for row-wise adjustment with (3,1); optional bug only if relevant. Correct: (3,2), axis=0 -> [4,4] (2,), axis=1 -> [5,4,3] (3,), pop vars [8/3,32/3], score [-2,2,6] (3,), T [[2,4,6],[8,4,0]], reshape [[2,8,4],[4,6,0]], corrected first row [3,6].
B: Two CSVs made from scratch in memory: records header zone_code,observation,second_s,following_pass,first_s and rows r,z8,8,0,2 | b,z7,4,1,4 | r,z5,0,1,6 | b,z6,4,0, | g,z1,2,0,0 | r,z4,6,1,8. Dictionary area_code,area_name rows b,Bay | r,Ridge | g,Glen. Join on zone_code↔area_code, six input and outputs, first missing once, keep zero, group obs sizes Ridge/Bay/Glen 3/2/1, valid first counts 3/1/1 and means 16/3,4,0, all-observed first mean 4 and pop variance 8, second mean 4 all six. Histogram first with [0,4,8,12] counts [2,2,1] and [0,6,12] -> [3,2]. Change empty value to 10, Bay mean becomes 7; overall first n=6, mean 5, pop variance 35/3; first histogram [2,2,2]. Distinguish records vs measures and interpretation. Use only the intended columns and named keys; physical order intentionally irrelevant. Different domain+semantics, actual code adaptation or independent parallel calculation. Do not demand this file run zero-edit against a fixed teaching CSV; probe lesson's taught path/explicit generalized claims and report who wrote any candidate-specific adapter.
C: Independently write elementary loop+function counting values meeting inclusive limit among observed [0,None,3,7,7]. Limit 7 -> 2; limit 0 -> 4; empty -> 0. Probe clear threshold and new-input behavior. Do not treat an alternative Python exercise as failing just because API differs. Also trace one deliberate wrong shape or wrong join concept and correct from the student's presented material. Feedback identifies where/how to revisit.
E: Report highest impact findings with precise cell/heading or line. Separate direct source reading; fixed mathematical oracle and executed fresh probes; candidate execution vs completing a lab ourselves; pedagogical judgement vs real student evidence.
